description:
Use this when the user wants their birth chart (kundli): ascendant, planets in signs and houses, yogas, the current planetary periods, or one of the classical sub-charts.
Sidereal chart: ascendant, the nine grahas, twelve houses, yogas and the life-period (daśā) timeline. A modern Western block is added unless `western` is false. With `location`, also astrocartography lines at that place and the chart's own frame relocated there. Includes two classical sub-charts by default; ask for any of the others with `divisionals`.
Cost: 1 credit per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209}}

birthData.description: The person's birth data: date, local time (omit if unknown), IANA timezone, latitude and longitude.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

divisionals.description: Classical sub-charts to include, by value. Default `d9` and `d10`; send [] for none. Each returns its ascendant and every graha's sign, degree and house within that sub-chart.

includeDasha.description: Include the life-period (daśā) timeline in the chart response. Default true.

location.description: Both coordinates or neither: a half-filled location is refused, never defaulted.

orbDegrees.description: Orb as a ground distance in degrees of great-circle arc (1 degree = about 111 km at any latitude). Widened for an approximate birth time; no lines for an unknown one.

western.description: Set false to omit the modern Western block.

name: get_chart

aspects.description: The five Ptolemaic majors by degree with orbs — a Western construction, not Vedic graha dṛṣṭi.

computationId.description: SHA-256 of every input that changes the result (birth date, time, coordinates, timezone, frame, daśā switch and depth, the `divisionals` requested): identical inputs give the same id, different requests never share one, and it never exposes the birth data.

relocation.description: Present when `location` was sent: this chart's own frame recomputed for that place.

western.description: Modern Western techniques, published alongside the Jyotiṣa engine and not part of it. Every object carries `tradition: "western"` and `classical: false`.

pratyantardashas.description: On each antardaśā when depth is 'pratyantardasha'.

DivisionalChart.description: One classical sub-chart. Houses count whole-sign from its own ascendant. Nakṣatra, quarter and dignity are natal concepts and are null here.

division.description: Which sub-chart this is: one of the `divisionals` values.

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

combust.description: Combustion (astaṅgata): true when the graha is within its orb of the Sun (Moon 12°, Mars 17°, Mercury 14° or 12° retrograde, Jupiter 11°, Venus 10° or 8° retrograde, Saturn 15°). null where it does not apply: the Sun, Rahu, Ketu and the outer planets. Natal chart only; sub-chart planets omit it.

distanceFromSun.description: Angular distance from the Sun, degrees.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

Yoga.description: A yoga formed in this chart. AstroNest does not rank yogas: there is no strength or score, only whether it is formed and what it rests on.

basis.description: What the yoga rests on in this chart, e.g. "Jupiter and Moon in kendra from each other".

strength.description: Always null: AstroNest does not rank yogas. Read basis instead.

title: Natal chart (kundli)
